lines.text: In his first oracle, Balaam says Balak brought him from Edom, and asks how he can curse those God has not cursed.
Balak takes Balaam to the top of Hermon, and Balaam says God is not a man that He should lie.
Balak takes Balaam to the top of Peor, where Balak offers a bull and a ram on seven altars.
